passages.title: Green Hill Elementary School Festival
lines: Come and enjoy our school festival!
Place: the school gym and the playground
Third graders will sing in the gym at 11:00 a.m.
You can buy curry and rice and fruit juice in the cafeteria.
At the cookie corner, you can make your own cookies. Please bring a bag to take them home.
If it rains, the playground games will move to the gym.

passages.title: Kiko's Diary
lines: Today I went to the zoo with my cousin Hana.
First, we saw the pandas. They were eating bamboo.
Next, we watched the penguins. They were swimming very fast.
Hana liked the giraffes the best because they were so tall.
For lunch, we ate rice balls under a big tree.
I was tired, but I was very happy.
Next time, I'm going to draw the animals in my notebook.
